titleBefore: Review your resume for a specific role before
description: AI Resume Review quickly shows how well your resume fits a vacancy, highlighting weak points, missing keywords, and concrete copy improvements.
previewText: Strengthen the summary for the target role, add more metrics, and move React, Next.js, and FSD higher in the resume.
capabilitiesText: More than a resume upload form: analyze and tailor a resume, translate it, compare roles, and export the result.
processText: The workflow is built for quick iterations: upload a resume, define the goal, apply improvements, and review the next version.
useCasesText: Make decisions based on a specific role and vacancy requirements instead of rewriting your resume blindly.

local.title: Runs locally
local.description: Resume text stays in the browser and is not sent to an external server.

target.title: Evaluates role fit
target.description: Compares the resume with the target position, ATS keywords, and vacancy requirements.

application.title: Supports applications
application.description: Prepares recommendations, translations, vacancy comparisons, and cover letters.

analysis.title: Resume analysis
analysis.description: Review the overall score, summary, experience, education, skills, keywords, and metrics.

recommendations.title: Text recommendations
recommendations.description: See weak points, strengths, missing keywords, and targeted rewrite suggestions.

ats.title: ATS and vacancy
ats.description: Paste a vacancy, compare keyword coverage, and identify what is missing for the role.

translation.title: Resume translation
translation.description: Translate the resume in a formal, concise, ATS-friendly, or recruiter-friendly tone.

comparison.title: Vacancy comparison
comparison.description: Compare several vacancies to see which one best fits the current resume.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter
coverLetter.description: Prepare a draft from the resume and vacancy, then tailor it for a specific application.

upload.title: 1. Upload a file
upload.description: PDF, DOCX, TXT, and MD are supported. Text is extracted directly in the browser.

target.title: 2. Define the goal
target.description: Add a role or vacancy to make the recommendations specific and actionable.

improvements.title: 3. Apply improvements
improvements.description: Use the score, recommendations, exports, and analysis history for the next iteration.

iterate.title: 4. Improve the resume
iterate.description: Refine key sections and increase the chances of a response.

application.title: Before applying
application.description: Quickly check how closely the resume matches a vacancy.

translation.title: Before translating
translation.description: Prepare an English version without losing structure or key wording.

roleChange.title: Before changing roles
roleChange.description: Identify which skills and achievements should be emphasized for a new position.
